// Plan_79 B3h / D3: wrappers remain valid when their callers use registry builders.
const refuse = (message) => die([message, renderOrderHeaderHelp(agent)].filter(Boolean).join('\n'));
function declareRefusal(message) { throw new Error(message); }
const forward = function (message) { refuse(message); };
refuse(orderRuleMessage('known-rule', { violation: 'known-violation' }));
declareRefusal(orderDiagnosticMessage('known-diagnostic'));
forward(orderRuleMessage('known-rule'));
